simple.meaning: חָלַק (châlaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 65 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 20 more, beginning at Genesis 14:15. Its contexts include family, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָלַק (H2505).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָלַק (châlaq) / H2505 is traced through Genesis 14:15, Genesis 49:7, Genesis 49:27, Exodus 15:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.

Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce;
“Benjamin is a ravenous wolf.
The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder.
“To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,
Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”
‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder?
Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”
He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.
Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

definitions.full: H2505. chalaq I. חָלַק verb divide, share (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic חֲלַק field , חוּלְּקָא portion , divide, determine, decree ; Arabic measure, measure off ; Assyrian e‡lu , possession , field , Jäger BAS ii. 296 ; Ethiopic : 1. 2, is enumerate , enumeration, number ) — Qal Perfect ׳ה Deut 4:19 5 t.; חָֽלְקוּ Josh 18:2 ; Imperfect יַחֲלֹק Job 27:17 ; Prov 17:2 ; 2 masculine singular suffix וַתַּחְלְקֵם Neh 9:22 ; 3 plural וַיַּחְלְקוּ Josh 14:5 ; יַחֲלֹ֑קוּ 1Sam 30:24 ; וַיַּחְלְקוּם 1Chr 24:4-5 , תַּחְלְקוּ 2Sam 19:30 ; Imperative חִלְקוּ Josh 22:8 ; Infinitive לַחֲלֹק Neh 13:13 ; Participle חוֺלֵק Prov 29:24 ; — 1 divide, apportion , followed by accusative (of gods) and לְ person Deut 4:19 ; 29:25 ; accusative not expressed Neh 13:13 (reference to offerings and tithes); with accusative (of land) Josh 14:5 (P), 18:2 (JE), 2Sam 19:30 : object people Neh 9:22 ; ׳ח עִם divide with others Josh 22:8 (D ?). 2 assign, distribute : Levites over ( על ) temple 2Chr 23:18 , compare 1Chr 24:4-5 ,. 3 assign, impart , followed by בִּינָה & לְ Job 39:17 . 4 share (in), followed by accusative silver Job 27:17 ; inheritance Prov 17:2 ; spoil 1Sam 30:24 (object omitted); followed by עם have shares with ׳ח גַּנָּב עם Prov 29:24 . 5 divide up = plunder the temple, followed by accusative 2Chr 28:21 (see Be). Niph`al Imperfect יֵחָלֵק Num 26:55 ; 1Kin 16:21 ; יֵחָ֫לֶק Job 38:24 ; וַיֵּחָלֵק Gen 14:15 ; 3 feminine singular תֵּחָלֵק Num 26:53 , 56 ; וֶַיּחָלְקֵם (Baer) 1Chr 23:6 ; 24:3 compare Be & below below Pi`el ; — 1 reflexive, divide oneself Gen 14:15 (i.e. one's men). 2 passive be divided: a. apportioned , the land Num 26:53 , 55 (by lot) 26:56 ( id. ); all P. b. of people , divided into two factions 1Kin 16:21 . c. of light , parted, spread abroad Job 38:24 . 3 transitive assign, distribute 1Chr 23:6 ; 24:3 , but transitive Niph`al is unlikely, see below Pi`el Perfect 3plural חִלְּקוּ Joel 1Chr 4:2 ; וְחִלַּקְתֶּם consecutive Ezek 47:21 ; suffix חִלְּקָם Lam 4:16 ; 3 feminine singular suffix חִלְּקַ֫תָּה Isa 34:17 ; 2 masculine singular suffix וְחִלַּקְתָּם Ezek 5:1 ; — Imperfect יְחַלֵּק Gen 49:27 4 t., etc.; probably read יְחַלְּקֵם 1Chr 23:6 ; 24:3 (see above Niph`al ), etc.; Imperative חַלֵּק Josh 13:7 ; Infinitive חַלֵּק 19:51 ; Prov 16:19 ; suffix חַלְּקָם Isa 9:2 ; — 1 divide, apportion: food, at festival 2Sam 6:19 , followed by accusative & לְ = 1Chr 16:3 , garments Psa 22:19 , sorrows Job 21:17 (no לְ ); give a portion to , followed by לְ (no accusative expressed) Isa 53:12 ; a land Joel 4:2(no indirect object) Josh 19:51 (P), also Micah 2:4 ; Psa 60:8 = 108:8 , Dan 11:39 ; followed by accusative & לְ Josh 13:7 ; 18:10 ; 1Kin 18:6 ; Isa 34:17 ; Ezek 47:21 ; divide hair (symbolic) 5:1 ; divide spoil ( שָׁלָל ) Isa 9:2 ; Prov 16:19 ; Gen 49:27 (poem), Exod 15:9 (song); Judg 5:30 ; Psa 68:13 ; Isa 53:12 . 2 assign, distribute: Levites to their service, probably 1Chr 23:6 ; 24:3 (see above) 3 scatter , followed by accusative Gen 49:7 (poem) (|| הפיץ ), Lam 4:16 .
